title: Input Validation
definition: Never trust client data. Input validation ensures that the `req.body` contains the exact fields, data types, and constraints you expect before hitting the database. You can use libraries like `Joi`, `Zod`, or `express-validator`.

answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
